title: Assault/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "A friendly colony has under a long-distance artillery barrage for several days. I've traced the attack back to an experimental cannon on the Queen's fortress. Break in and silence the gun."
- Lotus: "A distant colony has been under fire from the Queens' fortress for days. Destroy the Queen's experimental Navar Cannon and send the Grineer a message."
- Lotus: "The Queens' fortress is using a friendly colony near Jupiter as target practice for its new long-distance artillery. Breach the fortress and destroy the cannon."
- Lotus: "Pick up that Moltecoil. You will use it to breach the gates."
- Lotus: "The fortress entrance is heavily reinforced. You'll need that Moltecoil to destroy the gates."

- Lotus: "The Navar Cannon has a massive range, capable of hitting targets in far-off sectors. Up until now they've been testing conventional ammunition but we know that they are about to switch to devastating tectonic munitions. You can't let that happen."
- Lotus: "Right now, the Navar Cannon is just a menace, but once the Grineer switch to tectonic munitions it will become capable of obliterating colonies in a single shot."
- Lotus: "Plant the Moltecoil on the doors."
- Lotus: "Defend the Moltecoil while it melts the locking mechanism."
- Lotus: "The Moltecoil is super-heating the locking mechanism. Defend it from attack."
- Lotus: "The gates are down. Get to the Navar Cannon."
- Lotus: "The Moltecoil worked. Find the Navar Cannon."
- Lotus: "The Grineer know we're here for the Cannon. They're priming one last shot with a Tectonic round that is capable of destroying the colony in one hit. Do not let that happen."
- Lotus: "The Cannon is priming for a tectonic shot. Hurry, disable the Cannon's systems before it fires."
- Lotus: "You've reached the Cannon. Shut it down before it fires the tectonic shot."
**After hacking all three consoles within 140 seconds**
- "That's it. The Grineer are no longer in control of their cannon. Now it's time to turn their weapon back on them. Head to the control center."
- "You did it. The Navar Cannon is out of operation, but you're not done yet. Find the command center."
- Lotus: "No. You let them get off a Tectonic Shot. The colony now faces certain destruction. This mission is a failure."
- Lotus: "You're too late. The Navar Cannon has fired a Tectonic Shot at the colony. This is the worst-case scenario. Abort the mission."
- Lotus: "The command center controls the Navar Cannon's telemetry systems. Use it to take out that Galleon."
- Lotus: "This is the command center. You'll need to locate all three of the telemetry keys."
- Lotus: "You found a key. Take it to the console."
- Lotus: "Insert that telemetry key into the console."
- Lotus: "That's it. We have triangulation. Protect the console while I reprogram the Cannon's telemetry."
- Lotus: "Done. The Cannon's telemetry has been reconfigured. Return to the Cannon and pull the trigger."
- Lotus: "Direct hit. The Galleon has been obliterated. Now return to the telemetry system and make sure the Cannon stays silent."
- Lotus: "You let them destroy the console. You're out of options. Abort the mission."
- Lotus: "The targeting mechanism is out of commission. The Cannon is useless now. The Grineer will think long and hard before trying to use this weapon again."
